_comment: UrjaSetu Phase-2 Data Quality Fixture Manifest. Master index describing all data quality scenarios, test assertions, and schema references.

valid.description: Continuous, physically consistent 15-minute intervals for a 5 kW rooftop PV prosumer.
valid.test_assertion: Ingestion succeeds; time-series queries return monotonically increasing timestamps with valid quality flags.

missing.test_assertion: Gap detection identifies the 30-minute missing telemetry window and flags downstream forecasting/reconciliation.

stale.description: Frozen telemetry values persisting past the 15-minute freshness threshold, aged 150 minutes.
stale.test_assertion: Freshness monitor flags readings as stale; activates reliability path reducing market trading confidence.

out_of_order.description: Jittered packet arrival where interval readings arrive non-sequentially.
out_of_order.test_assertion: Time-series storage and query index reconstructs monotonic chronological order regardless of arrival order.

duplicate.description: Exact retransmissions and timestamp collisions on the same (meter_id, interval).
duplicate.test_assertion: Deduplication logic discards exact retransmissions and surfaces conflicts for auditing.

invalid_measurement.description: Negative generation, nameplate capacity breach, negative load, out-of-range battery SOC, inverted interval.
invalid_measurement.test_assertion: Quality filter rejects or flags anomalous telemetry prior to forecast ingestion and grid validation.
